title: Ablations, UNKNOWN calibration and the §13 metrics: each of the nine §13 ablations switches off one component in a scratch copy and reruns what it feeds, on Morph and, where the protocol says it applies, on the corpus (I51's c17) and the held-out sort pass; the 14 I48 controls run as T48 with the plan's budgets; every §13 metric read from its recorded source, with deltas against the I52/I52b baselines; results/eval/ablations.json and docs/M4_EVAL.md generated by a script

thresholds.full_system_values: read from the committed records at the run's tree, never from a rerun (protocol full_system)
thresholds.machine: the session's container: 4 CPUs, no GPU

predictions.claim: A1 (no sorts-as-types) on Morph: the ablated M3 derivation loses exactly the M3 laws of SORT's typed sub-forms (as_member, realize, reinterpret: 3 laws, one of them REFUTED) and gains none; M3 findings drop by 1; the code-basis §11.3 reproductions and §11.8 rows held do not change (O27 keeps its M2 SORT/site and M2/view links). On c17 the ablated derivation still derives no law.

A2 (no writer provenance): M3's derivation is unchanged (its sort assignment refines no register to an Idx or Cnt family, so no label exists to remove); M2's derivation changes at least one SORT/site law (lost or with a new statement hash) among the sites over the queue cursors; the code-basis §11.3 reproductions do not change (the writer-provenance class O16/O33 is reproduced, where it is, by M1/T32/M2-view laws, not by a sort site); the held-out sort pass still refuses, with the same message as I50's sealed refusal (results/targets/scroll/derive_refusal.json at 9f1462ed).

A3 (no evidence calculus): with an empty evidence set, M3's PAR sub-forms read from evidence atoms (round_trip, cross_component_codec, weak) derive nothing: between 70 and 90 M3 laws are lost, at least 2 of them REFUTED; no non-PAR law changes; §11.8 rows R1 and R2 lose their only code link (the pinned cross-component laws), so code rows held drop by 2; code-basis §11.3 reproductions do not change; intended asymmetries on the code basis drop (the intent-question triage disappears).

A4 (2-cycles instead of fundamental cycles): M3 loses exactly the laws of the off PAR sub-forms (15 laws: cross_component_codec 6, branch 1, weak 4, push 1, go_branch 2, go_recompute 1), 7 of them REFUTED; rows R1 and R2 lose their code links (code rows held -2); code-basis §11.3 reproductions do not change (no reproduced obstruction rests only on a non-2-cycle law).

A5 (no native-equivalence NAT): O15 (η₂ populates CSR only at the last committed index) is no longer reproduced on either basis, so hand and code §11.3 reproductions each drop by exactly 1; no §11.8 row changes; findings drop by 2 (M1's and M2/view's L_nat_eta2).

A6 (no enablement in DISCH): the dead set becomes empty and no action is excluded, so at least one M3 DISCH law gains an entry point or changes statement; the code-basis §11.3 reproductions do not change (O31 and O33 keep their M1/M2-view links); at least one M3 DISCH record's status changes after the rerun.

A7 (no replay): no REFUTED record of M0-M3 reaches the final filter's finding bin (from the committed count to 0), the witness replay rate becomes undefined (null) and refinement compares nothing; the §11.3/§11.8 verdicts do not change (statuses do not depend on replay); I62's mutation detection without the replay-corpus channel is no higher than with it.

A8 (single kernel): both known kernel-disagreement cases (replay/M1/kernel_mismatch and I97's kernel_fuel fixture) are accepted by bend2 alone and rejected (a kernel mismatch) when --verdict runs, so the disagreements surfaced drop from 2 to 0; no record keeps an independent second-kernel check.

A9 (no frozen statements): in the sandbox, at least 1 of the 12 attempts ends with a weakening the sandbox checker accepts (weakening rate > 0); A3 flags every accepted weakening; with the freezing checks on, no accepted weakening passes (accepted_with_freezing 0).

UNKNOWN calibration on the 14 I48 controls: no wrong decision; all 5 within-budget controls are decided as expected (depth_1, depth_2, value_1 REFUTED; constant_1, constant_3 PROVED); at least 7 of the 9 beyond-budget controls are UNKNOWN; every UNKNOWN record names what was tried.

On Morph, HOLON's code-basis count of reproduced §11.3 obstructions exceeds the number of obstructions each I52 baseline detects, so every Morph obstruction-recall delta (holon - baseline) is positive. Non-vacuity: holds only for baselines whose Morph file exists with status run on at least one target.

regressions.claim: The exit: results/eval/ablations.json names the nine §13 ablations, each with Morph status run, and every system status is the protocol's; docs/M4_EVAL.md and results/eval/metrics.json are generated (report --check reproduces them).

Construction: every ablation's headline numbers (findings, §11.3/§11.8 counts per basis, lost/gained/changed laws, per-rule recall) equal the instrument's recomputation from the detail file and the committed records; lost laws lie in what the switch removes.
Construction: the calibration rows are the 14 controls with I48's laws unchanged, their outcomes the committed records' statuses, and the metrics the instrument's.

Construction: every §13 metric is present per system with its source and value or a missing reason; the values equal the instrument's reading of the sources; canary acceptance is 0; every baseline delta is holon - baseline.
Construction: A9's rows are the protocol's 12 attempts; rate = accepted / attempts; nothing of the sandbox is committed.

Nothing in M0-M3 changes (no I53 non-merge commit touches their laws, results, gen, spec, facts, replay or tests, or a holon/ file outside holon/eval/), the runner names no target or corpus system, imports no test module and is in no generator closure; outputs are deterministic.
